text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 16 · 雨后连通城市的步行廊.
Environment:  An original near-future elevated pedestrian corridor after a light shower, wide curved pale stone path, off-white railings and broad translucent canopy, generous planters with sage foliage. Warm natural wood bench recessed at left, clean pale gray towers outside and a small pocket park visible below, very subtle wet reflections. Eye-level gentle curve creates depth and clear foreground for dialogue scene. Bright overcast silvery white daylight, minimal understated embedded lighting not neon, believable current-adjacent technology. Empty every level including distant windows and reflections.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 16 · 雨后连通城市的步行廊. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
